watch.title: Dhikr Counter
watch.description: Tap the fingerprint icon to count your dhikr. The rings show your progress.

watchBtnList.title: Dhikr List
watchBtnList.description: Open your saved dhikrs and load them into the counter.

watchBtnTarget.title: Set a Target
watchBtnTarget.description: Choose how many times to recite; the ring shows your progress.

watchBtnReset.title: Reset Counter
watchBtnReset.description: Reset the current dhikr counter to zero.

watchBtnSave.title: Save
watchBtnSave.description: Save the dhikr session to your account.

tapAnywhere.title: Tap Anywhere
tapAnywhere.description: While this mode is on, you can count by tapping anywhere on the screen — no need to tap the fingerprint.

tabFocus.title: My Dhikrs
tabFocus.description: Manage your saved dhikrs here and load them into the counter.

tabAiGuide.title: AI Guide
tabAiGuide.description: Get AI-powered personal dhikr recommendations; tracks your guide history.

tabSpecialDays.title: Special Days
tabSpecialDays.description: Don't miss kandils and religiously significant days; get notified.
